title: Barakel: The Fallen Angel
statusNote: Plays with Multiplayer set to No: logos, menu, help, the story intro and the first area (Norgaram Neighborhoods) work; the knight walks, inventory and quest log open. With Multiplayer left at Yes (the default) the game also starts, and waits for other players in the background; playing it with a second player was not tried. The dumped card also holds RealPlayer and a Videos app, which the installer refuses, so the zip is packed without them.
notes: The main menu has a Multiplayer switch, Yes by default. To play alone, move to it and press OK so it reads "Multiplayer:No"; with Yes the game starts too and listens for other players; joining it from a second player in the same room of the site (Menu > Multiplayer) was not tried.
A new adventure opens with an illustrated story that plays by itself for about 40 seconds before the first area loads.
In play the left soft key opens the menu (Play > Go to the game returns) and the right soft key the inventory. In the inventory 5 uses an object, 7 throws it away, 4 reads and 8 drinks.
Saving costs 200 gold, paid to the Wizard; after dying, use Resurrection in the game menu.

multiplayer.menu: Main menu > Multiplayer: Yes / No, then New Adventure

controls.source: The game's Help (controls during the game and in the inventory). Movement, the soft keys and * were also seen in play; attack, protect, spells and potion showed nothing with no enemy near, so they are as Help gives them. Help calls * "Enemy"; in play it showed the current adventure.

actions.up: Move up (press twice quickly to run)
actions.lsk: Game menu; next page (help, quest log)

notes: Arrows move. Space or Z attacks, X protects, C opens the spells, V drinks a potion, Tab shows the current adventure. Q is the game menu and W the inventory.

enhance.note: Ground, trees, plants, the knight and his shadow are drawn sharper. The game's own HUD panel, menus and text stay as the game draws them. The faint blue tint the game adds in the distance is missing.
